_about: Lore data (docs/lore/README.md; decisions 257, 258): entries with facts, each fact saying who knows it. Code uses only status agreed. Facts, never lines to say.

entries.name: the town
entries.summary: The people the players fight for; what is found on the road comes home to the town.

facts.text: Everything brought home goes into the town's shared stockpile.
People rescued from captivity come to live in the town and work their trade.
Who rules or speaks for the town.

entries.name: the goblins
entries.summary: They hold the overrun castle and raid the land around it.

facts.text: The goblins have overrun the castle near the town and hold it.
The goblins raided a farmstead near the castle and took the smith and his hammer.
The goblins win by holding things, captives and ground, not by taking loot.
The imp is small and darts in and out of a fight.
The brute is big and heavy, and it stands guard.
The sneak patrols and comes at you from the side.
What the goblins are: a people, beasts, or something made.
Whether imps, brutes and sneaks are one people or creatures the goblins keep.
Why they took the smith and his hammer.

entries.name: the Blood Rot
entries.summary: A clan whose lands lie under a blight.

facts.text: The Blood Rot's lands lie under a blight.
Who or what the Blood Rot are.
